path.description: Absolute path to the data file (.csv, .json, .jsonl, .tsv, .xlsx, .xls)

maxRows.description: Maximum number of rows to return for CSV/TSV/Excel files. Defaults to 200.

sheet.description: For Excel files only: the sheet name to read. Defaults to the first sheet. Call once without this to see the full sheetNames list, then call again with the sheet you want.
